The '''Gabon Mathematical Society''' (in [[French Language|French]]: ''Société Mathématique du Gabon'', '''SMG''') is a [[learned society]] of the mathematicians from [[Gabon]], recognized by the [[International Mathematical Union]] as the national mathematical organization for its country.<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/members/countries/list/sorted-by-names/gabon-associate-member/ Gabon (associate member)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150701154431/http://www.mathunion.org/members/countries/list/sorted-by-names/gabon-associate-member/ |date=2015-07-01 }}, [[International Mathematical Union]], retrieved 2015-01-24.</ref> It was founded in 2013 and its current president is [[Philibert Nang]], from the [[École Normale Supérieure, Gabon|École Normale Supérieure]], [[Libreville]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mathunion.org/fileadmin/IMU/Publications/CircularLetters/2014/IMU_AO_CL_3_2014-PB05-14_Application_Gabon_IMU.pdf|title=APPLICATION OF GABON FOR IMU ASSOCIATE MEMBERSHIP|accessdate=January 24, 2014|publisher=[[International Mathematical Union]]|format=PDF|date=March 6, 2014|first= Philibert|last= Nang}}</ref>
